items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I played there with him. So next time I went again, and I played again.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, Beville Park used to call it. See that?

In the real park. Well, one time there used to be for colored, the colored people had it once and then after they turned it into white. And it rained all that day, you know, and we had to play a dance. And the first dance we played Mr. Billy, the first day with our band. Anybody go to the dance? Oh, the place was packed. They couldn't go home? Oh yeah, it was packed Mr. Billy, that place was packed. So, and we went there and we played that dance that night. And from that, I'm going to tell you to Mr. Billy, that…
Maybe make a copy of it sometime.
